title: thelypteris fukienensis
intro: Thelypteris fukienensis, commonly known as Fukien fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris fukienensis include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, and its antimicrobial properties, which can help to fight off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
